LanguageData.APM_PressTheAttack.label: Press The Attack
LanguageData.APM_PressTheAttack.description: The Dominus emits a psychic pulse that influences nearby allies to ignore pain, move faster and stay in high spirits.
LanguageData.APM_Mech_Duel.label: the duel trial
LanguageData.APM_Mech_Duel.description: A selected target is chosen for a duel and a shield is generated around the duelists. For the duration of the duel, ranged attacks, abilities and Incoming damage increased. Additionally, if the duel does not end within a certain time frame, the duelists gain a harsh debuff. If either combatant dies or is downed, the victor gains a powerful temporary buff instead.
